name: Euler CFG++
plain: An Euler step that renoises along the unconditional prediction rather than the guided one, in the CFG++ manner. It still lands on the guided x0 and is deterministic. Because it needs the unconditional output it turns off ComfyUI's cfg=1 shortcut, so cfg=1 still pays for both passes.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
Calls euler_ancestral_cfg_pp with η=0, s_noise=0.
α_s=σ·e^{λ(σ)}, α_t=σ'·e^{λ(σ')}; d_u=(x−α_s·U)/σ; x'=α_t·D+σ'·d_u.
λ is half-logSNR, see sigma_to_half_log_snr.

props.stages: 1 (each call is 2 network passes even at cfg=1)
props.prediction_space: half-logSNR scaling factors with σ step; eps taken from U
props.flow_const: Handled by α factors (α=1−σ on CONST, 1 otherwise). No offset of σ=1: there α_s=0 and d_u=x.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: SamplerEulerCFGpp version=regular selects this. version=alternative is a different formula, see core-euler-cfg-pp-alternative.

label: from code
surprise: Not the same update as Euler: U replaces D in the renoise direction, and cfg=1 still costs two passes.
